lines.en: "Donna? Blue shirt? Badge? Nightstick? You are a policewoman?"
"Yep. You're a regular..." "Sherlock Holmes, I solved that mystery before you did."
"Okay, this is fun." "Andy, you are UFC legend Chuck Liddell."
"To me, Sherlock Holmes is literally the greatest character in the Western canon. Smart, intuitive, handsome."
"Replace his pasty British frailty with superhuman physical fitness, and you get... Sherlock Draeger."
"That's right. Hey, where's my lovely daughter tonight?"
"She's at home." "I knew that you would be here, and I was worried that you might be concerned seeing us together at night."
"You're a very thoughtful guy, but really, I have no problem with the two of you dating. Really, I mean..."
"Look at you. You're just, you know, beautiful."
"You're beautiful! Oh, on the inside, where your spirit lives."
"Listen, tell her, come to the party, and I don't mind at all."
"Look, you can text without looking at your phone?"
"I think it's rude not to maintain eye contact with people that I'm talking to."
"Look who decided to join the party, bro! That's awesome!"
"Honey, he's wearing a costume. He's going as lame."
"But, uh, I think the Batman costume's way better. You should go wear that."
"Yeah, I don't think I'm going to put on a costume, because I'm not really attending this party that's at my house."
"Hey, listen. If you're mad about something, you should just..."
"Really? Listen, I feel like you are mad, so maybe you should just talk to us about it."
"Thanks for that. Your fingers are salty. I'm gonna finish my work."
"Let's get together by your love on hand."
"I'm glad they think you did me well."
"We'll be out the closest to what I'm supposed to."
"I won't mention it, it would surely be."
"Can you at least tell me what you're doing? I'm a homeowner. I would like to actually learn something."
"Yeah. I'm tightening the valve stem into the valve shank. I'm replacing the handle. And then tightening the set screw, which will hold it in place. Now."
"Oh my god! We made it work!"
"It's a good feeling. Sense of accomplishment and pride. Damn it. I just love it so much."
"Great. I'm gonna go around this house and fix everything I can find that needs fixing. You want to help?"
"I thought you weren't coming to the party."
"No. If you're not part of the party, you can't have the candy."
"I have one sister. We steal each other's stuff. Hack each other's Twitter accounts. Set each other's clothes on fire. There are no rules."
"We need to deal with what's bothering you."
"See, you're angry at me, and you're not talking about it, and I'm gonna beat you up until you do because I'm mature."
"I grew up with five brothers, and we fought using the Dwyer method, which was yelling, wrestling, crying, followed by lots of hugs, and then more wrestling, but the fun kind, and then crying when
the fun kind of wrestling got out of hand."
"Not until you tell me what's wrong."
